thread:
marie-partnerships: Quick sync — ACME HW marketplace listing requires SOC2 attestation + a third-party infra pen test bundle. SI (Jordan) will supply scanner logs and a firmware attestation PDF. Target: embargo lift and joint announcement next Thu EOD. What exact artifacts and formats do Security/Legal need from the SI? @alan-security @nina-legal

alan-security: Thanks — short checklist from sec side: signed SOC2 PDF (certifying scope + date), pen-test executive summary (high/med/low highlights), raw scanner logs (full) shared via presigned S3 links under NDA, and firmware signing key attestation (HSM/KMS doc). Redaction rules: no plaintext customer data, strip IP addresses in screenshots unless necessary. Presign TTL preference: 7 days. :white_check_mark:

sam-engineering: Storage/ingest notes: we expect uploads to s3://marketplace-evidence/acme/<partner>/<artifact>. Please use this naming pattern and include sha256 sidecar. Max file size 10GB, multipart enabled. Example presign command for the SI to run (or for us to generate and send):

```
aws s3 presign s3://marketplace-evidence/acme/jordan/pen-logs.tar.gz --expires-in 604800
```

Also add a metadata.txt with: source, scanner-name, scan-date, sha256. We can hook the upload to an ingestion lambda that extracts metadata and tags the artifact in the catalog.

nina-legal: From legal: we need an executed NDA or an equivalent attestation of data handling before we accept raw logs. For the public announcement we can include SOC2 + "pen test completed by [vendor]" but not vulnerability specifics. Retention: evidence stored for 12 months by default, extendable on request. Please ensure partner signs the evidence-handling addendum (I can share template).

jordan-si: On it — I can package pen logs, Nessus/Trivy output, and firmware attestation. Two quick asks: 1) confirm presign TTL (alan said 7d ok) and 2) do you want a single tarball or separated files per artifact? Also will we need a notarized firmware signature or a simple vendor attestation PDF?

marie-partnerships: @jordan-si go with separated files per artifact (pen-summary.pdf, full-logs.tar.gz, firmware-attestation.pdf, metadata.txt). Alan + Nina: can you confirm that notarized signature is not required for initial listing (just an attestation PDF signed by partner legal)?

alan-security: Confirming: attestation PDF signed by partner legal is acceptable for listing. If the firmware signing key is hardware-backed (HSM/KMS), include a statement of that and any cert chain. If we plan to rely on the firmware signature for runtime verification in our infra later, we'll revisit notarization.

nina-legal: Confirmed — partner-signed attestation PDF is fine for launch. Keep record of signer name, position, and date. I'll DM the evidence-handling addendum and the public announcement language we prefer (high-level).

marie-partnerships: Timeline check — SI to upload by Tue EOD; security review Wed; legal sign-off Thu AM; announcement embargo lift Thu EOD. @deploy-bot can you hold announcement pipeline until legal signs off?

deploy-bot: Hold placed on "acme-hw-joint-announcement" pipeline until 2025-04-10T23:59:59Z or until manual release. Reason: awaiting SOC2/pen-test evidence and legal sign-off. :robot_face:

jordan-si: Acknowledged. I'll upload initial artifacts by Tue morning. Thanks team.

marie-partnerships: Awesome — I'll follow up with a one-pager for the partner with exact upload links, naming conventions, and NDA link. :pray:
